readme: Every haste source the calculator (js/haste.js) knows about, except item stats, which are parsed from Data Dragon item.json at runtime so they follow each patch automatically. Each entry carries verifiedPatch (major.minor); once the live patch is newer the UI marks it 'verified on X'. List stale entries with: node tools/stale-overrides.mjs. The live field says what Phase 3 can auto-fill from the Live Client API: a data path, 'self-only' (your own full rune page is exposed, enemies show only keystone + trees, so theirs stay manual), or null (never exposed: always manual). A grant is { kind, amount | perStack | byLevel, ... } where kind is one of: ability (all abilities), basic (Q/W/E only), ultimate (R only), summoner, item. Formula: cooldown x 100 / (100 + haste). Abilities flagged static in overrides.json ignore haste entirely.

2517.name: Endless Hunger
2517.note: 5 + 13% bonus AD (10% ranged) ability haste. Uses the side's bonus AD field.

4005.name: Imperial Mandate
4005.note: +20 ability haste on abilities with an immobilizing effect only - not applied automatically.

6616.name: Staff of Flowing Water
6616.note: Healing/shielding an ally grants you both +15 ability haste for 6s - temporary, not applied.

2522.name: Actualizer
2522.note: While Empowered, basic ability cooldowns progress 30% faster - not applied.

6675.name: Navori Flickerblade
6675.note: Attacks reduce basic ability cooldowns by 15% of their remaining cooldown - real cooldowns are shorter than shown.

6696.name: Axiom Arc
6696.note: A champion you damaged dying within 3s refunds part of your ultimate's cooldown.

buffs.name: Hextech Drake stacks
buffs.note: 5 ability haste per Hextech Drake your team has slain (max 4). Hextech Soul does not affect cooldowns. No other drake, soul, Elder, Baron or Atakhan grants haste.

buffs.name: Blue buff (Crest of Insight)
buffs.source: wiki: Crest of Insight ({{pp|10;15;20|1;6;11}}, changed in 26.14)
buffs.note: 10 / 15 / 20 ability haste at champion level 1 / 6 / 11, for 120s. The Live Client API cannot see buffs, so this stays manual.

buffs.name: Infernal Cinders (Infernal Rift only)
buffs.note: 1 ability haste per cinder picked up. Only spawn when the map becomes the Infernal Rift. Holding more than 5 when you die drops half of the extra.

runes.name: Transcendence
runes.note: Level 11+: a champion takedown reduces the remaining cooldown of basic abilities by 20% (not modelled).

runes.name: Ultimate Hunter
runes.source: Data Dragon runesReforged.json 16.19.1; wiki: Ultimate Hunter (31 at 5 stacks)
runes.note: 6 ultimate haste + 5 per Bounty Hunter stack (first takedown on each enemy champion, max 5).

runes.name: Jack of All Trades
runes.source: Data Dragon runesReforged.json 16.19.1; wiki: Jack of All Trades
runes.note: 1 ability haste per different stat type gained from items. No cap.

runes.name: Legend: Haste
runes.note: 1.5 basic ability haste per Legend stack (max 10). Does not affect the ultimate.

runes.name: Stat shard: Ability Haste
runes.source: wiki: Rune (League of Legends) - offense row only

runes.name: Axiom Arcanist
runes.note: A champion takedown reduces your ultimate's current cooldown by 7% (not modelled - no permanent haste).
